mapper.select:
SELECT c.COMMENT_ID, c.POST_ID, c.USER_ID, c.PARENT_COMMENT_ID, CASE WHEN c.DELETED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.CONTENT END AS CONTENT,
c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETED_BY_TYPE, CASE WHEN c.DELETED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN u.USER_STATUS = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE COALESCE(u.NICKNAME, '알 수 없는 사용자') END AS WRITER
FROM comments c INNER JOIN POSTS p ON p.POST_ID = c.POST_ID
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.USER_ID = c.USER_ID
WHERE c.POST_ID = #{postId} AND p.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND ( c.DELETED_AT IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments child WHERE child.PARENT_COMMENT_ID = c.COMMENT_ID AND child.DELETED_AT IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY c.COMMENT_ID ASC
SELECT COMMENT_ID, POST_ID, PARENT_COMMENT_ID FROM comments WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (POST_ID, USER_ID, PARENT_COMMENT_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
